title: iberis spathulata subsp. gastonis
intro: Iberis spathulata subsp. gastonis, commonly known as Rock Cress, is a plant species belonging to the Brassicaceae family. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Rock Cress are attributed to its ability to reduce fever, relieve pain, and soothe respiratory issues, making it a popular remedy for colds and flu. Bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids are responsible for its medicinal properties, which also include potential anti-cancer and anti-inflammatory effects.
